We will explore the coastal shores and marsh environment while pointing out many highlights of our area such as the historic lighthouses. We will view local nature and wildlife and the main objective will be to educate you about the Dolphins and get you close views of them. Your opportunity for photos will abound. blurb: Guests explore the waters of Hilton Head Island on private Zodiac raft tours focusing on dolphins, birdlife, salt marsh estuaries, and beachcombing. All tours are private for the members of your party only, with a maximum of 6 passengers per boat or up to 12 with two boats combined. The tours emphasize nature, ecology, and local history for a unique and educational experience.
